title: ARS Full QC Agent — Output (successQcReport | errorEnvelope · the terminal 3-verdict adjudicator)
description: Validates the polymorphic v1.0 output of the Full QC Agent (Agent #13 of 17 — the TERMINAL ADJUDICATOR: the last gate before a reel reaches a client's live surface, the 13th and final defense-in-depth firewall pass (the ONLY pass that re-DERIVES rather than verifies), and the FIFTH contractually mode-BLIND agent — completing the mode-agnosticism proof across the entire post tail, ingest -> publish gate). Authored Day 97 (Sat Jul 25 2026) from SPEC §3 Outputs (Day 92 outline) + §6.3 12-named-code/slot errorEnvelope mapping (Day 94 partial 1) + §10 Field Map (26 rows) + §10.4 schema authoring note (Day 94) + §12 deterministic verdict math (Day 95 partial 2) + §16 metadata block + §16 schema-day checklist (Day 95) + the Day 96 v1.0 LOCK CANDIDATE reconciliation. Polymorphism via top-level oneOf (mirrors AI Video Gen Day 14 + Style Replication Day 33 + QC Pre-flight Day 45 + Ingest Day 54 + Edit Director Day 62 + Editor Day 71 + Sound Day 79 + Motion Day 87 pattern — 9th reuse). DEFINING POSTURE — RESTORES the third verdict (D3): verdict enum is the FULL three-value set. On success the branch pins verdict const 'pass'; on error the branch pins verdict enum ['fail','reshoot'] — full QC is the terminal adjudicator, the ONLY post agent positioned to declare a defect un-fixable in post ('reshoot'). The pass/fail split is fully DETERMINISTIC (any §12 AND-term false => not a pass); the fail-vs-reshoot determination is the SINGLE judgment slot in the whole agent, isolated to non-pass routing so it can NEVER produce a false pass. Mirrors QC Pre-flight exactly — full QC is its TERMINAL TWIN. successQcReport <=> verdict 'pass'; errorEnvelope <=> verdict in {fail, reshoot}. Human deferral lives in human_review_required const true + publish_target.auto_published const false + publish_target.publish_mode const 'human_in_the_loop' + qc_measured_probe_run const false on EVERY emission (recommend-don't-publish, D14), NOT in a verdict branch. The success branch encodes the §12.1 15-term AND-of-gates HARD terms as const invariants — making a false-PASS STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE (false-PASS tolerance ZERO target, §8.2 / §12.3 property 4; a report that violates any gate term cannot even serialize as successQcReport): entity_firewall_pass_13.hits const 0 + status const pass (the re-DERIVED count — Check #6 does NOT trust Motion's declared 0), brand_voice_11_point.points_total const 11 + points_passed const 11 + per_point_evidence all result 'pass', format_spec all 5 booleans const true, caption_spec both booleans const true, cost_ledger.in_envelope const true, flag_adjudication.agents_reporting const 12 + unresolved const 0 + surface_complete const true (the accumulation-floor terminal closure NO other agent can perform), evidence_hash_chain all 4 booleans const true (the tri-anchor motion/audio/edl chain — the only pass that verifies all THREE at once), motion_self_check_adjudication.self_check_consistent_with_gate const true, mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read const false, publish_target.auto_published const false, qc_measured_probe_run const false, route_back_to const null. 12 named failure codes (§6.3, D8 confirmed as-drafted two-above the 8-10 target — the arithmetic of the terminal position: THREE brand surfaces + TWO cross-agent closures + a THIRD verdict) + slot-catch-all qc_agent_failed enumerated via enum — the LARGEST namespace in the fleet. The two routed pairs are enumerated as DISTINCT strings, NOT folded (master_unresolved + asset_uri_integrity_failure at Check #4; unresolved_upstream_flag + qc_flag_surface_incomplete as the Check #10 completeness-vs-closure routed family) — the D8 reduction (fold asset_uri_integrity_failure -> master_unresolved) is the operator's call and is NOT applied this run. qc_reshoot_required (the third-verdict code) + qc_lineage_failure are enumerated for schema-presence (exercised schema-only + runbook-probe per §9.1 fixture economy). route_back_to is a COMPUTED field (D8b), NOT a per-code const — three source-dependent route asymmetries (evidence_hash_break -> the broken anchor's agent; brand_voice_gate_fail -> the responsible authoring agent per failing point; the qc_firewall_breach/caption_spec_breach/format_spec_mismatch finish-vs-source escalation, Motion-first with detail.escalate_to editor-agent). qc_report_evidence_hash SHA-256 over the qc_gate + flag_adjudication + evidence_hash_chain block (^[a-f0-9]{64}$) on EVERY branch — tamper-evident verdict. asset/publish URIs ^ars:// platform-relative (Hard Rule #8 inherit — no absolute URL in a publish-queue artifact). human_review_required const true on EVERY branch (recommend-don't-publish — Hard Rule #13 / D14). SEVENTH-DEFERRED (Decision D7): parent_chain held additively (minItems 5, prefixItems 0-11, maxItems 12, items false) — accepts the 5-tuple through the 12-tuple full-QC append (qc_report_id, position 11). TODO@exact-n-hardening-migration: flip to minItems 12 (exact-12) ONLY inside the single separately-validated hardening migration, once the Sound 10-tuple + Motion 11-tuple LOCK. The 12-tuple is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (full QC is the SEVENTH forcing function; the §3.9 amendment itself is RATIFIED Day 79).

successQcReport.description: verdict='pass' branch (§3.1). Emitted iff every §12.1 AND-term is true (deterministic AND-of-gates, zero tunable thresholds): motion precondition ready AND upstream success AND tri-anchor hash chain intact AND master resolved AND 11/11 brand voice AND terminal firewall clean (re-derived hits==0) AND format parity (spec + promise) AND caption parity AND cost within envelope AND flag surface complete + closed (12 agents, 0 unresolved) AND motion-self-check consistent AND lineage valid. The gate terms below are const-pinned so a false-PASS cannot serialize (§8.2 0% false-pass target / §12.3 property 4). human_review_required is const true even on pass (a pass = cleared to advance to the human's publish decision, NOT published — D14).

qc_gate.description: The five terminal-gate adjudication blocks (§10 rows 6-19). Every sub-status is const-pinned to its PASS value on this branch.

brand_voice_11_point.description: The 11-point Brand Voice QC gate (§10 rows 6-8). points_passed==11 is the gate-pass invariant; per_point_evidence carries exactly 11 rows (populated for pass AND fail — the complete-diagnosis rule), all result 'pass' on this branch.

entity_firewall_pass_13.description: The 13th (terminal) firewall pass (§10 rows 9-12). hits is the ONE re-DERIVED field in the map — full QC computes its own count and does NOT echo Motion's declared banned_vocab_hits. hits const 0 + status const pass on this branch; scan counts equal the true field census.

format_spec.description: Format parity (§10 rows 13-14). Side 1 (promise): variants_match_promise. Side 2 (spec): aspect/resolution/duration/burn-in. All five const true on a pass.

caption_spec.description: Caption parity (§10 rows 15-16). parity_with_edl is BYTE parity (a near-match is a fail — an unlogged finish-layer copy edit). burn_in_text_firewall_clean is the caption-scoped slice of the re-derived firewall. Both const true on a pass.

cost_ledger.description: Cost-ledger closure (§10 rows 17-19). cumulative_usd echoed (NOT re-derived — Cross-SPEC §3.10). in_envelope const true on a pass. The ONE tier-aware surface (§10.5).

flag_adjudication.description: The accumulation-floor terminal closure (§10 row 20) — the check NO other agent in the fleet can perform. agents_reporting const 12, unresolved const 0, surface_complete const true on a pass. predicates_total is the TRUE counted census (>=48, the minItems-4 floor x 12 agents is the minimum, not the cap).

motion_self_check_adjudication.description: Motion's declared self-check echoed VERBATIM (§10 row 21) + the consistency verdict (row 22). self_check_consistent_with_gate const true on a pass — full QC's re-derived firewall count agrees with Motion's declared banned_vocab_hits. Never asserted true unverified.

tier_richness_echo.description: Tier echo extended with platform_variants_validated (§10 row 26) — the count full QC actually checked, which equals platform_variants_promised on a pass.

qc_measured_probe_run.description: The honest declaration that no frame was measured (v1.0 adjudicates the declared surface; the measured pixel/LUFS/fps probe is v1.1). const false makes a measured-probe claim UNREPRESENTABLE.

route_back_to.description: const null on a pass — a cleared reel routes forward to handoff_targets, not back. On the errorEnvelope branch this is a COMPUTED field (D8b).

handoff_targets.description: Forward handoff on a pass — the Localization Agent (#14) via the Drive publish queue holding store (D15 default). const single-element ['localization-agent'] in v1.0.

errorEnvelope.description: verdict in {fail, reshoot} branch (§3.2 / §6.3). failure_code is the 12-named + slot enum. verdict is enum ['fail','reshoot'] — 'reshoot' (the third verdict, D3) is emitted ONLY for a source-material defect un-fixable in post (routed to production-coord-agent); every post-fixable defect is 'fail'. route_back_to is COMPUTED (D8b) — the source determines the route; null only for the forensic-held lineage break (Check #12). human_review_required + qc_report_evidence_hash carried on this branch too (a routed verdict is still a tamper-evident, human-reviewed artifact).

verdict.description: §10.4 — the errorEnvelope branch verdict. 'reshoot' <=> failure_code qc_reshoot_required (the one judgment slot, §6.4, biased toward 'fail' on ambiguity); every other code => 'fail'.

failed_check_id.description: The §6.1 self-QC check id that produced the verdict (1-13). qc_reshoot_required carries failed_check_id 11 (the §6.4 fail-vs-reshoot slot); the slot qc_agent_failed may carry the terminal construction-integrity check id 13.

route_back_to.description: COMPUTED (D8b) — NOT a per-code const. The source determines the route: evidence_hash_break -> the broken anchor's agent (motion/sound/editor per detail.broken_anchor); brand_voice_gate_fail -> the responsible authoring agent per failing point; qc_firewall_breach/caption_spec_breach/format_spec_mismatch -> motion-agent (finish layer) with detail.escalate_to editor-agent if the defect originates in the EDL source; cost_ledger_overrun -> production-coord-agent; qc_reshoot_required -> production-coord-agent; unresolved_upstream_flag/qc_flag_surface_incomplete -> the named agent(s). null for qc_lineage_failure (held for forensic review, no ship verdict) and the generic slot catch-all.

detail.description: The per-code diagnostic payload (failing_points[], broken_anchor, unresolved[], missing_agents[], short_surfaces[], escalate_to, reshoot_considered, self_check_disagreement, promised-vs-delivered delta, etc.). Kept permissive — the fields present depend on the code.

attempts.description: Self-QC retry count (§6 retry policy — 2-strike, no third attempt). qc_agent_failed carries attempts==2.

failureCode.description: The v1.0 LOCKED-as-drafted namespace: 12 named codes (§6.3, D8 confirmed two-above the 8-10 target) + the qc_agent_failed slot catch-all. The two routed pairs are enumerated as DISTINCT strings, NOT folded (D8 reduction is an operator call, not applied): master_unresolved + asset_uri_integrity_failure (Check #4); unresolved_upstream_flag + qc_flag_surface_incomplete (Check #10 completeness-vs-closure). qc_reshoot_required (the third-verdict code) + qc_lineage_failure are enumerated for schema-presence (exercised schema-only / runbook-probe per §9.1). Slot naming: agent_id qc-agent -> qc_agent_failed (Cross-SPEC §3.6).

reelRefFull.description: §10 rows 3-5 — the cross-record audit join triple. qc_report_id is this agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7), also parent_chain[11].

perPointEvidenceAllPass.description: §10 row 8 — exactly 11 rows (minItems 11 / maxItems 11 — the gate size is canon, the array is exhaustive, the completeness rule at the type layer). Every row result 'pass' on the success branch.

evidenceHashChainIntact.description: §10 rows 23-24 — the tri-anchor hash chain (motion/audio/edl), the only place in the fleet all three are verified in one pass. All three legs + chain_intact const true on a pass; chain_intact is the AND of the three, never true on an uncomputed leg.

modeBlindConfirm.description: The FIFTH mode-blind self-attestation (D4 / §16 companion) — convergence FIVE stages deep, at the terminal gate. production_mode_read const false makes a mode-branching verdict UNREPRESENTABLE; consumed const 'mode_agnostic_v3_master'.

publishTarget.description: §10 row 25 / §16 companion — the no-publish / human-in-the-loop guarantee made machine-checkable at the terminal boundary (D14). auto_published const false makes an auto-publish forgery UNREPRESENTABLE; publish_mode const 'human_in_the_loop' ('automated' reserved for the v1.1 Publishing agent #16); the queue URI is platform-relative ars://.

qcPreFlagsEmitted.description: Full QC's own emitted predicates (§3.7 snake_case, >=4 — §6 Check #13). e.g. terminal_firewall_clean_pass_13, flag_surface_closed, evidence_chain_verified, mode_blind_gated. Appended to the upstream union without modifying it (§10.3).

costIncurred.description: §11 — the SEVENTH consecutive $0 agent. No engine/render/decode/measured-probe/publish surface; ~ $0.00-0.02 adjudication reasoning + optional hash re-verify only. No tier ceiling owned (the cost ledger it CHECKS is the reel's cumulative, not full QC's own).

brandId.description: v1.0 pilot brand (Sequel Digital entity scope). The HC/NPOX firewall BLOCK-list tokens are never a cross-entity reference.

arsUri.description: Platform-relative handle (Hard Rule #8 inherit) — no absolute URL in a publish-queue artifact (§6 Check #4 Part 2).

sha256Hex.description: qc_report_evidence_hash — SHA-256 over the qc_gate + flag_adjudication + evidence_hash_chain block. The tamper-evident verdict, emitted on EVERY branch.

parentChainHeld.description: SEVENTH-DEFERRED (Decision D7 / §10.4 / §16 addition 1). The 12-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY: prefixItems positions 0-11 = [brief_id, script_id, storyboard_id, production_plan_id|ai-video-gen|mode-c-direct, replication_set_id, preflight_report_id, asset_manifest_id, edit_plan_id, edl_id, audio_spec_id, motion_spec_id, qc_report_id]. positions 0-10 inherit the Motion parentChainHeld verbatim; position 11 is full QC's append (qc_report_id, UUIDv7). minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple inbound canon (pre-hardening); maxItems 12 ACCEPTS the 6-tuple through the 12-tuple full-QC append; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. TODO@exact-n-hardening-migration: flip to minItems 12 (exact-12) ONLY inside the single separately-validated hardening migration, once the Sound 10-tuple + Motion 11-tuple LOCK. This is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (full QC is the SEVENTH forcing function). The Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment itself is RATIFIED (Day 79) — this is a fixture-compatibility deferral, not an unratified-design deferral.

metadataBlockPass.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block + the 7 full-QC additions (§16). On the pass branch qc_report_class is const 'terminal_preflight_pass'. production_mode is PRESENT for lineage; the sibling root mode_blind_confirm attests it was never READ (D4). human_review_required const true; auto_published const false; qc_measured_probe_run const false.

metadataBlockError.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block + the 7 full-QC additions (§16), error branch. qc_report_class is enum ['terminal_preflight_fail','terminal_preflight_reshoot'] (matches verdict). auto_published const false + qc_measured_probe_run const false + human_review_required const true carried on this branch too.
